full_judgment: 2. The opposite party as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 69 of 1987 in the Court of learned Assistant Judge, Ishardi, Pabna for declaration of title in the suit land measuring an area of 1.16 acres appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 40, R.S. Khatian No. 107 plot Nos. 7 and 8 contending, inter alia, that the said land belonged to Haresuddin Mondal who died leaving behind one widow named Halima, two minor sons named Helal and Hedayetullah Nabi and a minor daughter named Hasina Khatun. For legal necessity of mirrors, their mothers Halima sold the suit land by a kabala deed dated 14.3.1961 in favour of Wahed Ali Sheikh. Wahed Ali Sheikh transferred by two kabala deeds dated 17.1.1967 and 4.3.1965 and area for 64 acres of land in favour of Hasen Ali Sheikh, the father of the plaintiff. Wahed Ali Sheikh being in possession in the rest of the suit land died leaving behind the plaintiffs, father Hasen Ali Sheikh as his cousin brother. This way Hasen Ali Sheikh became 16 anas owner in the suit land. Hasen Ali died leaving behind the plaintiffs as his sons and daughters and their mothers Soleman Bewa 'as his wife. The R.S record was Wrongly prepared in the name of the defendants. The defendants denied title of a part of suit land. Earlier the plaintiffs had filed Other Class Suit N. 436 of 1975 against the defendants. That suit was decreed exparte. The defendants submitted an application under Order IX Rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure but that was dismissed. Thereafter the defendants against died the title of the plaintiff in the suit land in 1987 and as such the such.
